title: Concrete Material
description: Detailed schema for concrete material settings used by GIRDER_MATL_PROP and SLAB_MATL_PROP in Modify Material.

CODE.description: Concrete design code. If CODE is 'None', enter a custom material NAME instead of selecting GRADE.

NAME.description: User-defined concrete material name. Used only when CODE is 'None'.

GRADE.description: Concrete material grade. Required when CODE is not 'None'.

COMP_STRENGTH.description: Specified Compressive Strength (f'c). When CODE is 'None', user input is required. When CODE is a design code, this value can be auto-filled from the selected CODE and GRADE.

FACTOR_VALUE.description: Light Weight Factor value. Required when CODE is 'None' and LIGHT_WEIGHT_FACTOR is true.
